title: 第5章 挑选基因第6章 契合度百分之七十二三寸石猴
slug: 神话纪元开局三寸石猴基因
content_zh:
;;
“猛虎基因？”
季知行来到摆放猛虎基因的金属台前，微微激发体内基因窍，他的一个基因窍内部立刻亮起十分之一的光芒。
这说明他和这份猛虎基因的契合度，约是百分之十。
至于另一个基因窍……
光芒只亮起了一点点，估计只有百分之一二。
低得离谱。
“最高才百分之十。”季知行心中暗叹，“太低了。”
他正要继续往前走，一道声音忽然响起。
“季知行，黄宇，余芷柔，你们直接上二楼就行。”
班主任贺雁冰招呼道：“二阶基因样本都在二楼，其余人就在一楼挑选基因，不要乱跑。”
“是！”
黄宇和余芷柔都满脸兴奋地应道。
“二楼？二阶基因？”季知行却心中一沉，“我只有一阶基因窍，上二楼能做什么？”
可他没办法拒绝。班主任当众点名，他总不能说不去。
季知行只能跟着往二楼走去。
“等会儿趁班主任不注意，再偷偷回一楼。”季知行边走边想，“一楼那么多一阶基因，希望能找到契合度与我在百分之五十以上的。”
二楼的布置和一楼几乎一样，宽敞的大厅里，一座座金属平台有序排列。
季知行扫了眼周围，除了他们三个，和他们一起上二楼的还有十几人。
但这十几人上了二楼后，居然有一名穿着一中校服的少年，被一名老师领着，向三楼走上。

“这是谁？”
“怎么上三楼了？”
“他是我们一中的崔文成，上三楼自然是因为他觉醒的是三阶基因窍。”
“三阶基因窍？这么厉害？”
登上二楼的十几人都露出羡慕神色。
“比不了！”
黄宇也摇头一叹。
“别想那么多，咱们先选基因吧，如果契合度高，日后未必不能进阶三阶。”
余芷柔直接走到一个个金属平台前，激发体内基因窍，近距离感应各种基因与自己的契合度。
“对，先选基因！”
黄宇应了一声，也走过去。
“既然上来了就试试。”
季知行也走到最近的平台前，微微激发基因窍。
结果毫无反应。
平台内静静放置的【铁甲犀基因】，他的基因窍连一丝光芒都没有亮起。
“果然不行。”季知行并不意外，“二阶基因，我能感应到才怪。”
他不动声色地走向下一处。
这里放的是【暴风狼基因】。
他激发基因窍，结果依旧一片死寂。
“意料之中。”

季知行面上没什么表情，继续往前走。
连续走过七八个平台，他的基因窍内始终一片平静，连最微弱的光芒都没有亮起。
“这些二阶基因，我一个都无法契约。”季知行有点咬牙，但也知道，这才是必然的。
毕竟他只拥有一阶基因窍。
“算了，别在这儿浪费时间了。”

"Tiger genes?"
Ji Zhixing came to the metal table where the tiger genes were placed and slightly stimulated the gene orifices in his body. One of his gene orifices immediately lit up with a tenth of the light.
This shows that his compatibility with this tiger gene is about 10%.
As for the other gene orifice...
The light only shone a little bit, probably only one or two percent.
Ridiculously low.
"The highest is only ten percent." Ji Zhixing sighed inwardly, "It's too low."
He was about to continue walking forward when a voice suddenly sounded.
"Ji Zhixing, Huang Yu, Yu Zhirou, you can just go to the second floor."
Class teacher He Yanbing greeted: "The second-level gene samples are all on the second floor. The rest of the people will select genes on the first floor. Don't run around."
"Yes!"
Huang Yu and Yu Zhirou both responded with excitement.
"Second floor? Second-order genes?" Ji Zhixing's heart sank, "I only have first-order genes, what can I do on the second floor?"
But he couldn't refuse. When the head teacher calls his name in public, he can't say no.
Ji Zhixing could only follow him to the second floor.
"Sneak back to the first floor later when the head teacher is not paying attention." Ji Zhixing thought as he walked, "There are so many first-order genes on the first floor. I hope I can find someone with a compatibility of more than 50% with me."
The layout of the second floor is almost the same as that of the first floor. In the spacious hall, metal platforms are arranged in an orderly manner.
Ji Zhixing glanced around and saw that besides the three of them, there were more than a dozen people going up to the second floor with them.
But after more than a dozen people went to the second floor, there was actually a young man in the uniform of No. 1 Middle School, who was led by a teacher to the third floor.
"Who is this?"
"Why are you on the third floor?"
"He is Cui Wencheng from our No. 1 Middle School. Naturally, he went to the third floor because he awakened the third-level genetic aperture."
"Third-level genetic aperture? So powerful?"
The dozen or so people who climbed to the second floor all looked envious.
"No comparison!"
Huang Yu also shook his head and sighed.
"Don't think so much, let's choose genes first. If the fit is high, you may not be able to advance to the third level in the future."
Yu Zhirou walked directly to the metal platforms, stimulating the gene orifices in her body and sensing the compatibility of various genes with herself at close range.
"Yes, choose genes first!"
Huang Yu responded and walked over.
"Now that you're here, let's try it."
Ji Zhixing also walked to the nearest platform and slightly stimulated his gene aperture.
The result was nothing.
The [Iron-armored Rhinoceros Gene] placed quietly on the platform did not even light up at all.
"Sure enough, it doesn't work." Ji Zhixing was not surprised, "It's strange that I can sense the second-order gene."
He walked to the next place calmly.
What is placed here is [Storm Wolf Gene].
He activated the genetic aperture, but the result was still deathly silence.
"Expected."
Ji Zhixing had no expression on his face and continued walking forward.
After walking across seven or eight platforms in a row, his gene orifice was always calm, not even the faintest light came on.
"I can't contract any of these second-order genes." Ji Zhixing gritted his teeth, but he also knew that this was inevitable.
After all, he only possesses a first-order genetic aperture.
"Forget it, don't waste time here."
